about: One real fixture per instrument for the decode-parity test. 'file' stays null until tools/parity_sample.py picks it on the machine that holds the data; the test finds files by SHA-256, so the manifest holds hashes, not paths. No data is committed.

LASCO.want: C2 and C3 native FITS, one frame each; also one C2 frame from the 2025-08-21..31 pointing gap

PUNCH.want: L3 PTM (3-plane cube) or CTM; test every plane
